# Introduction

## Use Case & Motivation

Course Objectives:

- In groups carry out in R the entire data science process on a concrete use case.

- Using a reference dataset, demonstrate the process from data acquisition to the development of a prototype solution.

- Presentation and documentation of the solution engineering.

The project presentation should include the following points:

- Project objective (qualitative and quantitative objectives) \[4 points\]

  - Use case presentation, problem definition, motivation, objective

  - What are your goals? (qualitative/quantitative)

  - What are your deliverables? Timeline, milestone plan, etc.

- Description of the data source (reference dataset) \[4 points\]

- Project organization and allocation of tasks \[4 points\]

- Project development plan (workflow), backlogs \[4 points\]

- Answering

This is a book created from markdown and executable code.

See @knuth84 for additional discussion of literate programming.
